alt://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/sitesv-images-rt/AMxu72vKcTLObw7EE8KK5EeqjUQmLUcGHv2Kg9OjbupzbJftJd6Vkk2eQryaZ7OBlizG9cZ4bIUpe3-wrl5D7eFw1PAHuvKB9ThGq-poIip6503_r0I2n9NZWJUA3nqBlha29NXCB8BN2VRdlqV2tw9thoS8Ok97URKHGnfTLrdZ7n910WQeOGyv47ddmxQfpNymRYEH-EfA8_77dNfeYDEjW3k3Qz6KAwbDZ64GtGMSgkY=w1280|USS LEFTWICH was the 22nd SPRUANCE - class destroyer and the second ship in that class decommissioned. Stricken from the Navy list on March 27, 1998, the LEFTWICH was then berthed at the Naval Inactive Ship Maintenance Facility (NISMF), Pearl Harbor, HI, until she was sunk as a target on August 1, 2003, at 022° 48' 47.0" North, 160° 34' 00.0" West. The USS LEFTWICH was homeported in Pearl Harbor, HI., and was the first ship in the Navy named after Marine Corps Lieutenant Colonel William G. Leftwich, Jr.
